title: Terms of (2n + 1)/(n + 3) entering the ε-band
caption: Each term is 5/(n + 3) below 2. With ε = 0.5 the rule N > 5/ε − 3 gives N = 7: from n = 8 on, every term is within 0.5 of the limit 2 (the 8th term is 17/11 ≈ 1.545).
alt: A rising curve for (2n + 1)/(n + 3) flattening towards the dashed line at 2, crossing the dashed line at 1.5 when n = 7.
description: The terms (2n + 1)/(n + 3) rise towards the limit 2, always below it.
The lower dashed line, 1.5, is the edge of the band of width ε = 0.5 around 2.
The curve meets 1.5 where 5/(n + 3) = 0.5, at n = 7: that is N = 5/ε − 3.
After n = 7 every term lies inside the band, and a smaller ε only moves N further right.

checks.name: the 8th term is 17/11, inside the band
